mypy_note: Baseline at 91 after TASK-185b bouncer/ package. GATE5T advisory-only until TASK-189+ clears the baseline.

abandoned_tasks.reason: Task spec was wrong -- GATE3 run_verifier.py uses ast.literal_eval to load MANIFEST from the file AST, which cannot resolve name references. MANIFEST = _PACKAGE_MANIFEST would cause GATE3 to fail. The 182b inline MANIFEST is required by TASK-185.
